per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: Distinct strings confused with histories or a preliminary result reproved
per_claim_checks.resolution: Read official B4(b) and accepted equality of rates. The new claims apply to the accepted lambda and do not reprove part(a).

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: An infinite arbitrary obstruction subset may not inherit a finite-state model
per_claim_checks.resolution: Reconstructed the append/remove suffix bijection using the actual subset, factor-freeness and no proper suffix-prefix overlaps. No finite-state or regularity assumption is needed.

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: A reciprocal formal series may have a convergent boundary or a multiple zero
per_claim_checks.resolution: Positive factorial counts are submultiplicative and at least rho_G^n, so the series diverges at R_G. Monotone limits with G(R_G) finite give D_G(R_G)=0 even when R_G=R or the zero is multiple.
First moments converge uniformly on the closed interval. The missing tail has Hprime(R)<=A. If A=0, nonnegative positive-degree terms force H=0 and G=F. The proof explicitly separates that case.

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: Off-by-one cutoff or a bound only on a subsequence of caps
per_claim_checks.resolution: Agreement through2D+1 means N=2D+2 for every integer D>=1. The reciprocal ratio is lambda/rho_G=R_G/R and rho_G<=2, giving the stated1/(D+1) error uniformly.

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: A possibly infinite Gsecond(R) invalidates monotonicity
per_claim_checks.resolution: EG derivative is used only in the open interval. Gprime is continuous at R by finite first moment, so monotonicity extends to the closed interval without a second moment at R.

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: A trial outside the unknown convergence boundary of F is used in the proof
per_claim_checks.resolution: The contradiction assumes r<=R and differentiates only there. The actual rational G and its derivative converge at the chosen trial because its loop denominator is strictly positive.

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: Subtracting prefix coefficients without a justified word-set intersection
per_claim_checks.resolution: The accepted infinite F3 is an actual subset of F. Its prefix through24 is exactly z12+2z17+z20+4z22, with z4 already in P24. This proves the exact union and N25 agreement.

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: A rounded eigenvalue or unjustified bisection sign used as proof
per_claim_checks.resolution: Independently cleared denominators to a degree40 integer polynomial, proved its numerator negative and the plain P24 numerator positive at the fixed trial, then matched both reduced author fractions exactly. No search, new histories, factors, queues or automata.

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: Improved enclosure treated as an exact growth evaluation or imported external theorem
per_claim_checks.resolution: All premises are explicitly accepted project results. No new external theorem, full grammar, tail complement, regularity/algebraicity or novelty is inferred.
